# Layout package

Canonical layout runtime.

## Rules

- Active layout handle is always `|PREFIX` or `|PREFIX.suffix`
- Active instance alone defines what is painted
- Background instances may keep updating their own state
- Instance state is written under the matching storage root, for example `|Q.llama -> $Q.llama`

## Bundled modules

- `buffer`
- `editor`
- `q`
